Omar Hassan: Hi team 1 I need to request a recurring prayer break (15m) during my day for religious reasons. My manager scheduled my mid-year review the same time and I'm worried about how stepping out will be recorded.
Leah Brooks: Thanks for telling us, Omar. We can accommodate short recurring breaks. Do you want People Ops to draft a note to your manager to schedule around it?
Omar Hassan: Yes please. The prayer window is daily ~12:30-12:45pm. If possible keep reviews outside that window. I can also do remote review if needed.
Dina Cho: People Ops can start the accommodation discussion. For recurring religious practice we don't need medical docs. We'll coordinate schedule changes and a manager guidance memo. Interim: mark your calendar as busy and we'll ask manager to avoid scheduling evaluative meetings then.
People Ops (bot): @Omar 1 Created ticket ACC-5129 to log recurring religious accommodation. Facilities will add a small quiet room roster if you want an on-site space.
Leah Brooks: I'll move your mid-year to 11am or 3pm. Which do you prefer?
Omar Hassan: 3pm works best. Thank you. Also would like a short line in the manager note asking to categorize any brief step-outs for prayer as non-punitive.
Dina Cho: Noted. We'll send template now.
People Ops (bot): ```To: Leah Brooks
From: People Ops
Subject: Support for recurring religious accommodation (Omar Hassan)

Leah 1 Please schedule evaluative meetings to avoid Omar Hassan's daily 12:30-12:45pm prayer window. Treat brief step-outs for religious practice as non-punitive. People Ops logged ACC-5129 and can help coordinate space if needed.```
Leah Brooks: Done 1 moved review to 3pm and updated calendar invite. I won't mark attendance issues for this.
Omar Hassan: Really appreciate it. I'll RSVP to the new invite and let you know if I need a quiet room on-site.
Dina Cho: We'll leave this thread for tracking. Ping us if anything changes.
